categories.main_business_segments: Teradata operates through three primary geographic segments: Americas (North America and Latin America), EMEA (Europe, Middle East, and Africa), and APJ (Asia Pacific and Japan). The company’s business is centered around its connected multi-cloud data platform for enterprise analytics, supported by consulting and support services. Its offerings include cloud and on-premises data analytics platforms, consulting services, and support/maintenance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Teradata’s core technology is the Teradata Vantage platform, which includes VantageCloud (cloud-native and enterprise versions), ClearScape Analytics (in-database analytics and AI/ML capabilities), and VantageCore (on-premises offering). The company leverages a cloud-first, multi-cloud architecture, integrating with major public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and supporting hybrid deployments. Hardware components are assembled by Flex Ltd., while software is developed in-house using agile methodologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Teradata targets large enterprise customers that are heavy users of data and analytics, focusing on industries such as Financial Services, Government, Healthcare and Life Sciences, Manufacturing, Retail, Telecommunications, and Travel/Transportation. Its customers are typically organizations with complex data management needs and large, diverse user bases.
categories.geographic_coverage: Teradata operates in approximately 40 countries, with its headquarters in San Diego, California. In 2022, 58% of revenue came from the Americas, and 42% from international regions (EMEA and APJ). The company maintains 44 facilities in 31 countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Teradata is positioned downstream in the supply chain, delivering end-user data analytics platforms and services directly to enterprise customers. It relies on Flex Ltd. for hardware assembly and preferred suppliers for components, but its primary value is in software, analytics, and services delivered to customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Teradata’s strategic focus is on being a cloud-first, multi-cloud data platform leader for enterprise analytics. R&D is directed toward enhancing cloud-native capabilities (e.g., VantageCloud Lake), deepening integration with cloud ecosystems, expanding advanced analytics and AI/ML, and simplifying customer migration to the cloud. The company invests significantly in R&D to maintain technology leadership and support innovation in analytics, data integration, and open platform interoperability.
categories.revenue_model: Teradata generates revenue primarily through subscription-based software and cloud services, with flexible pricing models including fixed capacity, consumption-based ('pay as you go'), and ratable subscription revenue. Additional revenue streams include consulting services, support/maintenance, and, to a lesser extent, perpetual software licenses and hardware sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include cloud data vendors (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake), traditional enterprise data and analytics providers (IBM, Oracle, SAP), and open-source providers. Teradata differentiates itself by focusing on large-scale, complex, multi-cloud and hybrid analytics workloads, and is recognized as a leader in cloud-based analytics by industry analysts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Teradata reported $1.795 billion in revenue, with a 6% year-over-year decline primarily due to foreign currency impacts and ceasing operations in Russia. Public Cloud ARR grew 77% year-over-year, while total ARR was stable at $1.48 billion. The company had net income of $33 million and approximately 7,000 employees globally. Management expects a return to revenue growth in 2023, driven by cloud adoption.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Teradata’s value proposition centers on its ability to deliver scalable, secure, and highly concurrent analytics across multi-cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. Its platform enables integration of diverse data sources, supports advanced analytics and AI/ML, and offers flexible deployment and pricing. Teradata emphasizes ecosystem simplification, portability, and total cost of ownership, targeting enterprises with the most demanding analytics needs.
